title: A few beading techniques, and you can make earrings, necklaces and bracelets you'll actually wear
alt: Small bags and tubes of red, blue, green, gold and pink glass beads laid out beside a ruler.

posts.facebook:
A few simple techniques are enough to make jewelry you'll actually wear.

Beginners' classes teach stringing, crimping (squeezing a tiny metal bead flat to secure the end of the string), knotting between beads and simple wire wrapping. The first pieces are usually earrings, necklaces and bracelets.

In London, City Lit, an adult education college, runs a four-Saturday introduction and supplies most of the materials and tools. In the US, community colleges and craft centers run beginners' classes too.

Who would you make your first piece for?

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/learn-beaded-jewellery/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
